paragraphs: Mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 3:5, reporting in the name of R' Simon, in the name of Reish Lakish.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ש״ר פ״ג-ה is read contextually as Shemot Rabbah chapter 3 section 5, not a chapter range 3–5. No named edition is independently checked.

Of Lod translates לודייא without independently establishing residence. The reporting chain remains Shimon, Simon, Reish Lakish in that order. Full ריש לקיש remains Reish Lakish; the other two title abbreviations remain R'.
